git_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing Pagure-managed Git repositories.

db_path.description: Absolute path to the SQLite database storing webhook registration and delivery metadata.

host.description: IP address or hostname the webhook server should bind to.

port.description: Port number for the webhook server to listen on.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging and developer-friendly error pages.

workers.description: Number of worker threads/processes to handle webhook delivery.

webhook_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a webhook endpoint to respond.

webhook_retries.description: Number of times to retry failed webhook deliveries.

webhook_retry_delay.description: Delay (seconds) between retry attempts for failed webhooks.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS using provided certificate and key.

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL/TLS certificate file (required if SSL enabled).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL/TLS private key file (required if SSL enabled).

allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed hostnames for webhook origin verification (e.g., to prevent SSRF).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (CRITICAL, ERROR, WARNING, INFO, DEBUG).

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty, logs to stdout.

webhook_endpoint.description: URL path prefix where webhook endpoints are served.

webhook_methods.description: HTTP methods accepted for webhook delivery (e.g., POST, GET, PUT).

triggers.description: List of event types and whether they trigger webhook delivery.

event.description: Event type name (e.g., push, pull_request, issue, commit_comment).

enabled.description: Enable webhook delivery for this event type.

rate_limits.description: Rate limiting configuration per event type (requests per minute).

event.description: Event type to apply rate limit to.

requests_per_minute.description: Maximum number of webhook deliveries allowed per minute for this event.

proxy_url.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for outgoing webhook requests (e.g., http://proxy.example.com:3128).

custom_headers.description: Map of custom HTTP headers to include in outgoing webhook requests.

secret_token.description: Secret token used to sign webhook payloads with HMAC-SHA256 (recommended for security).

pagure_url.description: Public base URL of the Pagure forge (used for generating absolute links in payloads).

metrics_port.description: Port for the metrics server (only used if metrics enabled).
